$comment: Labeled retrieval eval for the encode-ui registry RAG index. `expect` is the RELEVANT SET — a hit is any expected item appearing in the top-k. `kind` groups queries by what they stress: intent (synonym/paraphrase the substring ladder cannot reach), behavior (described by what it does), api (technical/compositional), exact (name is in the query — lexical should win), a11y (accessibility affordances), negation (precision probes — `forbid` lists items that must NOT appear in the top 5, scored as violation@5; a negation query usually also has a true answer in `expect`), absence (`expect` is EMPTY — the registry genuinely has nothing for this; scored via the top-1 cosine calibration, and `forbid` may name a known trap). `forbid` is allowed on any kind. eval/queries.ts validates every name against the index and enforces the kind invariants; themes (registry:theme) are deliberately unlabeled.
